title: Four in court after newborn baby girl stabbed to death in Sheffield
description:
Two men and two women accused of murder, causing or allowing death of a child, and perverting course of justice

Four people have appeared in court charged with murder after a newborn baby girl was stabbed to death in Sheffield.

Two men and two women were remanded in custody on Wednesday following the death of the newborn named only as Baby S.
